column1: # Complete package source evidence for parser-format-package.

column5: The complete leaf package is transcreated as Rust-native formatter and restore-context authorities across tidb-datatype and tidb-ast: stateful indentation, flat formatting, output escaping, all 21 restore flags with source bit positions and priority, writer-bound restore methods, special comments, and scoped CTE tracking; arbitrary Go byte strings normalize to Rust UTF-8 and downstream AST-node packages are not credited.
